name: L'Heure Bleue
source:
Main character appears before  sisters with wounds on his back and head that result in memory loss.
He is received warmly in the mansion, and life goes on normally. That is, until the day when dreadful memories start to  recover...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-january-2005-tenshi-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公出现在一对姐妹面前，背部与头部都带着伤，并因此失去了记忆。
姐妹们在宅邸中热情接纳了他，生活也如常继续。直到有一天，那些可怕的记忆开始复苏……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-january-2005-tenshi-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
